evals.prompt: Summarize the top article on dev.to that isn't a challenge or contest announcement
evals.expected_output: A structured summary with title, TL;DR, Cliff Notes, Share, and Comment sections

expectations.text: Output contains an H1 title (line starting with '# ')
Output contains a clickable link to the source URL near the title
Output contains a '## TL;DR' section
TL;DR is 1-2 sentences of plain body text, not rendered as a heading or bold block
Output contains a '## Cliff Notes' section
Cliff Notes contains a bulleted list with 5-8 items
Output contains a '## Share' section
Share section contains a code fence with a bare URL on its own line
Output contains a '## Comment' section
Comment section contains a code fence with content of 20 words or fewer
